article_content: The Brickyard Vintage Racing Invitational at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway will feature hundreds of vintage vehicles from the past 100 years, including iconic cars like the 'Yellow Submarine' Chaparral and 'Ol' Calhoun. Indy 500 winners Al Unser Jr. and Buddy Lazier will participate in the event, which aims to celebrate a time when race cars were more interesting to look at. The event is sponsored by the Sportscar Vintage Racing Association, a group dedicated to preserving and restoring vintage race cars.

article_content: The United States and the Philippines have signed a nuclear cooperation pact, which will facilitate U.S. investment and technologies to aid the Southeast Asian nation's shift towards cleaner energy and bolster its power supply. Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken witnessed the signing of the deal on the sidelines of the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in San Francisco. The pact, known as a Section 123 agreement, will support the development of reliable, affordable, and sustainable power in the Philippines.

article_content: The upcoming fantasy film 'Damsel' stars Millie Bobby Brown as Princess Elodie, who takes on a dragon instead of waiting for a knight to save her. The film, directed by Juan Carlos Fresnadillo, was initially scheduled for release in October 2023 but has been rescheduled for 2024. The cast also includes Angela Bassett as Princess Elodie's stepmother, Lady Bayford.
